en.name: Dental Bridges
en.meta_title: Dental Bridges: A Fixed Solution for Missing Teeth
en.meta_description: Restore your smile and chewing function with a custom dental bridge. Learn how this fixed prosthetic device can 'bridge the gap' of a missing tooth, preventing teeth from shifting and maintaining your facial shape.
en.meta_keywords: dental bridge, missing tooth replacement, fixed bridge, restorative dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, replace missing teeth

what_is.heading: What is a Dental Bridge? Bridging the Gap
paragraphs: A dental bridge is a fixed prosthetic device designed to literally "bridge the gap" created by one or more missing teeth. It is an excellent and reliable solution for restoring your smile, your ability to chew properly, and the overall integrity of your bite.

how_it_works.heading: How a Dental Bridge Works
paragraphs: A traditional bridge consists of one or more artificial teeth (called pontics) that are held in place by dental crowns cemented onto the natural teeth on either side of the gap (called abutment teeth). This creates a strong, non-removable restoration.

benefits.heading: Benefits of a Dental Bridge
paragraphs: By filling the space of a missing tooth, a dental bridge prevents the remaining teeth from drifting out of position, which can lead to bite problems and jaw issues. It also helps to maintain the natural shape of your face and distribute chewing forces evenly. Our bridges are custom-made from high-quality materials to match your natural teeth, ensuring a result that is both functional and aesthetically pleasing.
